name: SFI-Bench-websearch
description: SFI-Bench-websearch is designed to evaluate model performance on web-search related tasks such as query formulation, retrieval, and ranking of web results. It measures how well models can generate queries or select relevant documents given a search intent and assesses ranking quality. The dataset is applicable to research on neural retrieval, query generation, and search-oriented evaluation.
reputation: Relatively low-profile dataset for evaluating web search and retrieval capabilities, with limited community adoption.
